pattern: EX-06 invoice before visit / date conflict carried into the invoice: aborted-visit fee for a date that was never agreed; RC Tenant Fees Act forbids the tenant recharge; CF provider says the tenant missed it, the record shows the agency notified a wrong date
notes: Mutation of the real record. Events 001-028 unchanged. Appended 029 (new): Keystone Compliance's job report and invoice KC-24817 on 8 September: element £38.00, labour £62.50, 'Aborted visit 30/08/2025, no access, tenant not home' £60.00; subtotal £160.50, VAT £32.10, total £192.60; asks the agency to recharge the £60 + VAT to the tenant. Appended 030 (new): the tenant confirms by phone the oven works. History truncated after event 030. The repair lines (£100.50 + VAT = £120.60) are uncontroversial. The £60 line is not: the 30/08/2025 date was a Saturday labelled 'Monday morning' in the agency's own notifications, the tenant had arranged 8 September, and the Tenant Fees Act does not allow the charge to be passed to her in any case. Expected: record the work result; record the invoice; do not recharge the tenant; query the aborted-visit line with Keystone (evidence the 30/08 visit was agreed and attended) and hold payment of the disputed amount; tell the landlord the cost position and ask how they want to proceed; do not close as paid at £192.60. Escalating the fee dispute to a human is acceptable but not required.
